title: Local hypercohomology of a normalized coefficient square
statement: Let $v:Z\to X$, $f:X\to S$, $k:Z\to T$, $g:T\to S$ satisfy $vf=kg$, and let $\varphi:F\to v_*G$, $q\ge0$, $V\subseteq S$, injective resolutions $I,J$ and restricted-resolution data $R,R^{\prime}$ on $U=f^{-1}V$ and $U^{\prime}=v^{-1}U=k^{-1}(g^{-1}V)$ be given [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Let $c_f,c_k,d_g$ be the normalized comparisons [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-local-models], $K=Rk_*G[0]$, $A(\varphi)$ the coefficient-square map [lem-weil-pbc-derived-square-unit-map], and $\lambda_g$ the local Leray comparison [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-top-edge]. Then $c_f;P_S^q(A(\varphi))_V;\lambda_{g,K,V};d_{g,K,V}=H^q(\varphi_U);c_k$, where the h-map on the right is moduleCohomologyFMap of restrictedDirectImageMap [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. This is an equality of maps into local derived hypercohomology before sheafification; it assumes no map e or equation for a sheaf edge.

proof.text: Factor both existing endpoint comparisons into classical section cohomology followed by raw local hypercohomology.

Choose the injective replacement ell:v_*J→L and augmentation lift beta:I→L using the proved natural-indexed resolution and lifting lemmas. Extend the roof by zero. Local sections of ell are a quasi-isomorphism: use the unbounded local direct-image sections theorem and exact evaluation on U.
Apply the raw derived-square roof action equation and the one-morphism restricted classical roof equation. They have the same numerator HΓ(beta) and denominator HΓ(ell).
Postcompose with the inverse target raw comparison and the invertible denominator, then cancel them. Associativity gives precisely the unchanged asserted equality.

theorem square_localHypercohomology {X S Z T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (k : Z ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ S) (v : Z ⟶ X) (h : v ≫ f = k ≫ g)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Z.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward v).obj G) (q : ℕ)
    (V : S.Opens) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (J : InjectiveResolution G)
    (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
    (R' : RestrictedResolutionSections J (v ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))) :
    (squareLocalResolutionComparison f F q V I (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) rfl R).hom ≫
      ((RingedSpace.localHypercohomologyPresheaf S.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ)).map
        (derivedSquareUnitMap f k g v h F G φ)).app (op V) ≫
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray g.toLRSHom.toShHom (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) ≫
      (squareInverseOpenComparison g (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G))).hom.app (op V) =
    moduleCohomologyFMap (v.resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (v ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl)
      (restrictedDirectImageMap v φ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) q ≫
      (squareLocalResolutionComparison k G q (g ⁻¹ᵁ V) J (v ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) (by
        rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, h]) R').hom
